products.title: Bag Scarf
products.body_html: A touch of elegance in every detail. The Velantra Bag Scarf is crafted from soft, lightweight silk blend fabric and designed to drape effortlessly around your favorite Velantra bag. Whether tied on the handle, worn as a hair accessory, or styled around your neck, it adds a refined pop of color and personality to any look.

products.title: Boat Tote Keychain
products.body_html: A miniature ode to the original. The Velantra Boat Tote Keychain captures the charm of the iconic tote in a collectible form. Crafted with premium materials and detailed stitching, it’s the perfect accessory for your keys, bag, or gift set—small in size, big on style.

products.title: Velantra Boat Tote
products.body_html: The signature that started it all. The Velantra Boat Tote combines timeless craftsmanship with effortless utility. Made from heavy-duty canvas and finished with genuine leather trim, it’s structured yet relaxed—built to elevate everyday errands, commutes, and weekend escapes. Spacious, refined, and instantly recognizable, it’s the definition of casual sophistication.

products.body_html: A structured ivory canvas mini tote with a hand-tied ribbon bow threaded through gold grommets — the little carryall that finishes a linen dress, a boat day, or a Saturday market run.

products.title: Velantra Horse Charm
products.body_html: A nod to timeless equestrian elegance. The Velantra Horse Charm is handcrafted from smooth leather and finished with precision detailing, designed to clip effortlessly onto your favorite bag. Sophisticated yet playful, it adds a refined touch of personality and heritage-inspired charm to any look.

products.title: Velantra Meridian Tote
products.body_html: Sophisticated yet functional, the Meridian Tote embodies modern versatility. Crafted from premium grained leather with a softly structured shape, it’s designed to carry your day—laptop, planner, and all—without sacrificing style. Finished with polished metal accents and reinforced handles, it’s the perfect balance of form and function for the woman always on the move.
